final_classification_basis: Original labels plus frozen blind repeat reading; unresolved design disagreements conservatively retained as ambiguous
classifier_identity: First set: 36 inherited labels with reader/model unrecorded plus 10 completed by OpenAI Codex (GPT-6); blind repeat: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6). No independent human validation is claimed.

inherited_records.relationship_to_current_file: All 36 row values are unchanged in the completed first label set.
inherited_records.reader_system_and_model: Not recorded for these inherited classifications; earlier notes call the activity hand validation without establishing a human reader or a model identity.

first_reading.comparison_interpretation: The frozen blind repeat used Codex (GPT-6), the system documented for completion of the first set. Agreement is reported as repeatability, not independence of model errors or accuracy against a human expert reference.

second_reading.reader: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), separate metadata-reading pass by submission-format agent
second_reading.prior_context: The agent inherited earlier summary counts and some example classifications; this is not a blinded or human independent validation. Classifications/evidence were recorded afresh from source metadata before opening the first-label CSV.
adjudication: TP53 00000068: 'yes (p53-null axis)' and 'yes' denote the same archived alone arm.
CARD11 00001215/00001226: no separate archived alone arm is documented; edited-cell allele configurations remain unresolved. 'no' versus 'unknown' reflects these different questions.
CARD11 ratio labels 'no' versus 'NA' agree that no numerical WT:mutant ratio is established for the ambiguous archived designs.

blinded_second_reading.reader_identity: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), two fresh-context agents reading disjoint halves

design_agreement_statistics.interpretation: Repeatability of nominal design labels; not accuracy against an expert reference standard.

blinded_second_reading.arm_comparison_scope: Five mutually verified mixed designs only; first-pass NA labels outside this group do not answer the blinded codebook's broader standalone-arm question.
blinded_second_reading.final_adjudication: Every design disagreement remains ambiguous; no forced consensus or post hoc replacement of frozen labels.
blinded_second_reading.limits: Blind repeat AI-assisted metadata reading; agreement measures repeatability, not accuracy against an expert standard or recall/prevalence. HAP1 labels in 00000097/00000658 infer haploid context without direct ploidy verification.

publication_table_compilation.method: A separate Codex-assisted source check followed archived publication identifiers to the relevant article methods, figures and supplements; verified designs and ambiguous records were then tabulated with evidence locators. This check did not alter the frozen metadata labels.
publication_table_compilation.limits: KCNQ2 linkage uses deposit metadata and a candidate article abstract only; the three disputed metadata-only records have unverified publication links. Publications' separate validation assays are distinguished from archived assay arms.

ambiguous_designs.urn:mavedb:00001204: Unresolved first/blinded reading discrepancy; retained as ambiguous. Base editing in cancer cell lines does not establish which cells retain WT alleles/protein of each edited gene. An analysis assumption of WT genome and bulk VAF thresholds are not evidence of a controlled same-cell mutant:WT protein mixture; no alone arm is established.
ambiguous_designs.urn:mavedb:00001206: Unresolved first/blinded reading discrepancy; retained as ambiguous. Endogenous base editing in HT-29 cells is documented, but retained same-gene WT alleles or protein in edited cells are not established. The WT-genome statement is an analysis assumption. Variant allele frequencies are genomic edit outcomes, not mutant:WT input or protein fractions.
ambiguous_designs.urn:mavedb:00001215: diploid saturation genome editing of CARD11; edit zygosity not stated
ambiguous_designs.urn:mavedb:00001226: diploid saturation genome editing of CARD11; edit zygosity not stated
ambiguous_designs.urn:mavedb:00001240: Unresolved first/blinded reading discrepancy; retained as ambiguous. The additional plasmid is an OmpR-regulated GFP reporter, not WT EnvZ. However, the bacterial experimental strain and its endogenous EnvZ genotype are not specified, so same-gene WT background cannot be resolved.

limits: Verified designs were found by the same screens and a review of the broader screen; detection fractions are not unbiased recall estimates.

The two label sets use archived metadata. A separate publication/design table checks linked source methods where available; it is not part of the blinded reading. An other label means that a qualifying design is not documented in the screened fields.
All strict, broad, ratio and controlled-keyword matches are classified; no probability sample of unflagged records was reviewed, so recall and archive-wide prevalence are unestimated.
No interval is assigned to the five purposively selected designs: they are not a probability sample of the archive.
A bicistronic construct fixes the DNA-level co-expression design but does not state an achieved protein fraction.
